structured_output.what_is_happening: FearOfMovingOn ($fomo) is a pump.fun coin that migrated to PumpSwap right away (created and migrated at the same unix time). Its first 12 minutes followed a classic pump-and-dump. It reached an all-time-high price of 2.06e-4 (about $205k market cap, per GMGN), then collapsed to 4.64e-5 (about $46k), roughly 77% below the top. The 5-minute change is -55% on DexScreener and -72% on GeckoTerminal, and sells now outnumber buys (m5: 485 unique sellers vs 394 buyers). The detection trigger fired on the volume spike of that dump. The creator has closed out ('creator_close'). A copycat token with the same name (AFHDV..., created 7 minutes later) already exists.

narrative.description: Aesthetic 'liminal 4:07 AM' meme about the fear of moving on, with a pun on FOMO. The only real, current 'fomo' story is the Fomo social trading app, which has been beating Pump.fun on revenue in September 2026. This token isn't connected to that app. It only borrows the ticker.
narrative.why_spreading: No organic spread found. Activity looks like launch-sniping volume plus a ticker that echoes the trending Fomo app.

token_connection.why_this_token: The project's website and X handle match the token name, so it is the original 'FearOfMovingOn'. The $FOMO ticker, though, is heavily reused and loosely borrows from the hype around the Fomo app.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 older FOMO tickers, plus a same-name FearOfMovingOn copy (AFHDV...) launched about 7 minutes later.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 69 bundler wallets, 19 snipers and 404 fresh wallets out of about 499 holders. The dev has sold. No paid boosts and no DexScreener profile. No posts found on X or anywhere else.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is poorly indexed by search engines, so there may be KOL or call-channel pushes I couldn't see.

structural_risks: Price is already about 77% below the ATH and sellers dominate the current 5 minutes
About $18.6k of liquidity against $600k+ of churned volume

structured_output.counterargument: LP is 100% burned, mint and freeze authority are renounced, top-10 holders own only 13.7%, and 861 unique buyers is a big early crowd. A shakeout from $205k to $46k could bottom out, and a bounce back toward $100k (a 2x) is plausible if a KOL or the Fomo-app ticker confusion brings in new buyers.
unknowns: Content of the project's X account

source_coverage.notes: Web search for the contract and name returned nothing relevant. News results only covered the unrelated Fomo app. The site is a poetic landing page with no contract address set. Time limit prevented Reddit, Telegram and Discord searches.

structured_output.thesis: A dumped launch with no found organic narrative, bundled and fresh-wallet trading, and a dev who has exited. Entry lands mid-collapse, so both a 2x before a -50% stop and a pair dying are more likely to go against the trade.
